categories.title: Tutorial
categories.description:
Tutorial

These interactive tutorial rounds contain step by step instructions for learning the basics of clonk control.

Every player should complete these scenarios to get to know the most important elements of the game.

categories.title: Worlds
categories.description:
Worlds

These worlds are there to be conquered by settlement. Mine resources, build up villages and production facilities, create supply chains and look after your population.

The landscapes in these scenarios are randomly generated at startup and will thus offer new challenges each time you play them.

The level of difficulty will slowly rise with each new world. While in the beginning there may be simplified rules for building and supply, towards the end you will experience the full complexity in the life of clonks.

categories.title: Missions
categories.description:
Missions

These scenarios present the player with clearly defined game goals. You have to complete each mission before the next one becomes accessible.

Quite often typical Clonk skills are required to solve each problem - bridges have to be built, mines dug, tunnels made water tight or resources have to be mined in order to produce the necessary tools.
�

categories.title: Melees
categories.description:
Melees

This is a collection of traditional melee scenarios in which two or more players can battle against each other in various settings.

categories.title: Races
categories.description:
Races

This folder contains a number of racing scenarios in which the objective is to reach the other end of the playing area before any of your opponents.

It goes without saying that this typically includes a lot of complications, surprise, and hectic activity.
�

categories.title: Knights
categories.description:
Knights

Honed blades, shining armor, streaming banners, comely maids.

This is the world of knights and kings, castles, and noble steed.

In this book you will find numerous medieval scenarios - all set for team play of two opposing parties - ranging from simple field camps to siege and escalade of mighty castles.

categories.title: Far Worlds
categories.description:
Far Worlds

Independent clonk peoples with their own customs and architecture can be found here in the Far Worlds. Over time, those clonks have adapted to their specific environment and have developed new tools and structures.

In each world you will encounter wholly new and complex rules and concepts regarding settlement, production, and supplies. Accordingly, these worlds are more suitable for advanced players.

categories.title: Fantasy
categories.description:
Fantasy

These worlds are filled to the rim with magical energy.

Alchemy will introduce a complete new spell system where the correct mixture of magic ingredients counts.

In crystal valleys, mages meet to compete with the complete range of new spells of the Fantasy pack.

Burning skies see mounted dragons rise to battle and the Dragon Rock calls for bold adventurers to rescue the princess.

categories.title: Western
categories.description:
Western

Endless stretches of unsettled land, the prospect of finding gold riches, and adventures beyond imagination have lured more than one hardy clonk into the Wild West.

Single or cooperative players can lead Indian tribes, make their way through uncharted terrain as trappers or gold miners, or found and build complete settlements.

Melee players will find desperado towns, cavalry forts attacked by bandits, or full blown bank robbery campaigns for many an hour loaded with action.

scenarios.title: A Clonk
scenarios.description:
A Clonk

This round demonstrates basic clonk control: running, jumping, digging.

Using the flag, you can turn a cabin into your home base where you can reload life energy and sell gold.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Air Travel
scenarios.description:
Air Travel

The flag needed for the home base can be reached by traveling from one sky island to another using the hot air balloon.

Then you will have to build bridges using loam chunks to get back to your cabin.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Production Line
scenarios.description:
Production Line

Trees can be chopped down and cut to wood in the sawmill. Wood can be used as firing fuel or to create new structures.

Buy a lorry at your home base, collect all wood and a chunk of ore and create a piece of metal in the foundry.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Gold Mine
scenarios.description:
Gold Mine

Use the construction kit found in the home base to build a new elevator.

Create an elevator shaft and a tunnel down to the vein of gold.

Chunks of gold can be blasted free using flint stones and then sold in the home base.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: More Clonks
scenarios.description:
More Clonks

This round can only be completed through teamwork of several clonks.

To construct an elevator to your home base, construction material needs to be flung across a valley from different positions using catapults.

Once completed, all clonks can reach the home base using the elevator.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Underground
scenarios.description:
Underground

Your objective is to retrieve a single crystal chunk and sell it at your home base.

Unfortunately, the area is not completely earthquake-safe.

With the material available in this round, you can build an elevator. The elevator will require energy supply which can be created with the power plant by burning coal.

Getting the layer of water out of your way might require some thought.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Acid Lake
scenarios.description:
Acid Lake

Another crystal chunk has to be retrieved and taken to the home base.

To get across the lake you need to build a new hot air balloon in the workshop. This will require construction material which can be bought in your home base.

The money you need to buy new material can be obtained by mining gold.

To get back from the other side of the lake you can use the sailboat. But take care when boarding!
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Wipf Rescue
scenarios.description:
Save The Wipfs

These furry little creatures enjoy running and jumping around the place.

Your objective is to catch all wipfs by hand or using the lorry. Take them to your home base and sell them.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Arctic Ocean
scenarios.description:
Arctic Ocean

The most hardened clonks will settle even in this hostile environment.

Build an igloo and gain 100 points by selling fish that you catch in the sea.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Lava Lake
scenarios.description:
Lava Lake

Once more a crystal has to be retrieved and sold.

But this time the crystal lies on the bottom of a boiling lava lake. 

To reach it, you have to build a pump and use it to drain the lake.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Arctic Ocean
scenarios.description:
Arctic Ocean

One of the biggest challenges for any settler.

Raising a settlement here is extremely difficult. Material supply in the home base is very limited.

The goal is to work your way down through the icebergs and extract all oil found underneath the ocean floor.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Ashlands
scenarios.description:
Ashlands

A barren valley, scorched by a recent volcanic eruption. However, abundant natural resources promise attractive rewards.

Take care when building, as periodic heavy rains may intefere with your plans. Prepare to move underground.

The goal is to exploit the resources and gain 1500 settlement points.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Ore=3; Coal-Swirl=4; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: The Chasm
scenarios.description:
The Chasm

This volcano is known as the most dangerous of the Southern reaches.

The main caldera alone is immense. Additionally, countless small veins of lava search their way through the flanks of the hill.

But, alas, not even this will deter a true gold miner.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Ore=3; Coal-Swirl=4; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Desert
scenarios.description:
Desert

This place is always hot and dry. Also, there are poisonous snakes about.

Underneath the sand you can find oil fields which can be mined using pumps and derricks.

The goal is to extract all oil, fill it into barrels, and then sell those at the home base.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Foggy Cliffs
scenarios.description:
Foggy Cliffs

At the Northern end of the known ocean lies a group of islands called Foggy Cliffs. The group consists of a number of very steep islands in temperate if rather cold climate.

Since the area sees lots of persisting winds but hardly any thunderstorms, it is quite suitable for wind power generation. There are none of the really valuable resources such as gold or oil to be found, however, you will be able to make a living of what is there.

The goal is to achive 2000 settlement points.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Gold Mine
scenarios.description:
Goldmine

Mining gold is one of the most basic activities in Clonk.

The goal of this round is to mine all available gold and bring it to your home base.

Start out by collecting and selling loose chunks of gold. From the money gained you can buy flint stones to blast free solid veins of gold.

No material is needed for construction and machines like the elevator do not require energy.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Lava Caves
scenarios.description:
Lava Caves

In these hot, lava flooded caves you will encounter monsters of various types.

Your goal is to eliminate the monsters and gain 1600 settlement points.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Mountain Range
scenarios.description:
Mountain Range

A group of brave settlers has made their way to this rough mountain terrain.

You might encounter earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or meteorite impacts.

Your goal is to mine all ore found in the hills.

Costruction material is not required in this round, but you will need to supply machines such as the elevator with energy by building windmills and connecting them using line construction kits.

As soon as you have gained enough wealth, you can buy additional flags and attach them to new homebase buildings.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Outset
scenarios.description:
Outset

An elementary settlement scenario for beginners. The goal is to achieve 400 settlement points. 

Settlement points are awarded for selling valuable materials such as gold, but also for building new structures.

In this scenario, construction requires raw materials. Rocks can be found underground, trees need to be chopped and processed in a sawmill, metal can be bought at the home base.

Energy supply is not yet necessary.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Sky Atoll
scenarios.description:
Sky Atoll

According to legend, a large group of sky islands with immense amounts of gold is hidden in the fogs above the center of the ocean.

Your goal is to find this Sky Atoll and mine all gold found there. Since the area is haunted by dense fog, rain, and thundertorms, this will not be an easy task. Build pumps to avoid the forming of lakes or flooded mines. All players start with a single blimp East and below of the atoll.

Hint: since you will do some risky climbing, always keep a clonk in reserve.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Sky Islands
scenarios.description:
Sky Islands

Each player starts on an island floating in mid-air.

One wrong step can mean inevitable death. Be careful when moving around.

Construction requires building material and machines such as the elevator or the sawmill require energy which can be generated using windmills and the transported to the consumers through power lines.

The goal is to achieve 1000 settlement points.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Tropical Island
scenarios.description:
Tropical Islands

Stranded on a tropical island, with just enough building material for a bamboo hut and a flag which can be used to turn this hut into a home base.

New buildings will require construction material. 

You can buy enough wood at your homebase to build a sawmill which can then be used to process chopped trees into more wood. 

Separate energy supply is not required.

The goal is to raise a functioning settlement and then to mine all gold from the earth.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Water Caves
scenarios.description:
Water Caves

Beneath an ancient dormant volcano Southeast of the great desert a lake has formed from ground water inside a system of caves with suprisingly flourishing plant and animal life.

But beware, the caves are very dark. Use torches to lighten your settlement and you may well succeed in conquering this underground world. Torches can be built on the anvil and attached to tunnels walls.

The goal is to achive 4000 settlement points. Hint: there's a huge vein of gold and crystal at the bottom of the lake.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Ore=3; Coal-Swirl=4; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Frontier
scenarios.description:
Frontier

A single clonk enters impassable territory. He will have to make it across over to an abandoned cabin to start a new settlement from there.

To complete this round, build up a whole city, consisting of at least a big castle, two guard towers and six stone houses.

Be careful with what little resources you can buy at your base. You will have to set up a complete functioning industry for wood and metal to support your major construction sites.

Up to eight players can help with the task.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Funnel Valley
scenarios.description:
Funnel Valley

It is hard to create a settlement in this narrow vale. But a few clonks have set out to try it anyway.

It is recommended to build bridges across the valley and channel the rain water, then create elevators to reach the lower levels.

The goal of this round is to mine all available gold.
�
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Up High
scenarios.description:
Up High

Finally, the holy statue of the sky clonks was rediscovered. A long time ago, the king of the sky clonks had sent this statue to the clonks in the mountains as a sign of peace. But during transport, a terrible meteor rain destroyed the blimps and the statue broke into many pieces and fell from the sky.

Now the feet of the big statue were found. You've built up your base next to site. Your goal is to rebuild the statue. You will have to find all parts of the statue and lower them to the ground. Don't worry, they won't break. If they are near the statue, they will be attached automatically.

The problem is with the landscape: it is very high and full of floating islands. To the first islands you'll get with loam alone, later you'll need a balloon and other tools. But perfect knowledge of controlling clonks is necessary to get to the higher levels.

To make it fair, buildings don't need energy and can be built without material. The round will be won when the statue is in one piece again.
�
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: The Last Will
scenarios.description:
The Last Will

Jeremy, Samuel and Edward are despaired. Their father, old farmer MacFlury, has fallen very ill. The three brothers stand by the bed and watch the old farmer. Suddenly, MacFlury opens his eyes for the last time and utters his last will with a hoarse and weak voice: he wants to be buried in the sea. After saying these words, MacFlury's eyelids shut forever.

Jeremy, Samuel and Edward have never seen the sea. They do not know which way is the fastest to get to the ocean and they do not know what will expect them on the way. But the three brothers decide not to disappoint their father's will and so they start the long and dangerous journey.

They put the dead farmer on a barrow for transportation and set out. After the first day of walking, they reach a lake. On the other side, the three brothers can see the rough outlines of a castle in the fog, but they do not know how to get there. Swimming across the lake is not an option because Jeremy, Samuel and Edward could not take their father with them. A wooden bridge is needed - but how can they build one?
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Deep Down
scenarios.description:
Deep Down

Shortly after the statue of the sky clonks was reassembled, disaster struck again. A great volcano erupted just at the site of the reassembly. The statue was torn apart and its fragments were lost in the depths of the lava crevices. 

Your goal is to make your way through the dangerous underworld of the volcano back up to the holy site, find all lost fragments and take them back to the assembly site to reconstruct the statue.

Beware: this is a very demanding scenario and for experienced Clonk players only. Through the whole mission, you have only one clonk available. You will find food for the ascend in the lorry that you have brought along. You will also gain energy when reassembling the statue. Structures do not need building material or power supply.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Pearl Diving
scenarios.description:
Pearls

Your objective is to retrieve all the shells with pearls from the bottom of the lagoon and sell them at your base.

Soon you will find it hard to do this by mere diving. You will have to construct tunnels to access the water at deeper points.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Rattlesnake Canyon
scenarios.description:
Rattlesnake Canyon

Ambitious pioneer clonks have received news of a large occurence of gold at the far end of the country. 

They have established a small camp and now need to create a road across canyons and mountaineous area.

Wooden bridge segments can be created in the workshop and then used to overcome the river gorges.

As distances between camp and miners increase, a steam engine pulling and wagon will server for speedy transportation.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Regeneration
scenarios.description:
Regeneration

You find yourself in a desolate country ravaged by an acid rain storm.

With just a little hut to start you will try to rebuild a complete settlement to bring new life to this forsaken land.

Very little resources can be bought, but you will find plenty in the ground.

The goal is to achieve 2500 settlement points.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Thunder Rock Mountain
scenarios.description:
Thunder Rock Mountain

Watch out! This round is a dangerous one. The valley near the Mount Deadly is not a very safe surrounding.

But this shall not deter an experienced miner such as you.

The critical point is mainly the energy; power plants need material, wind mills do not work underearth and usually get hit by rocks very easily.

This round will be won if all ore is mined and sold.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Seven Keys
scenarios.description:
Seven Keys

Countless myths are told about the arcane portal on top of the Pinnacle of Seven Storms. It is said that a mighty portal throwns on top, which no Clonk has ever managed to open yet.

Objective:
You must find 7 key objects and deliver them to a portal on the top of the hill.

Key objects are created whenever there is no other key object and a clonk approaches the portal. Each object will have unique features, so feeding it to the portal won't be trivial. The portal will give a hint concerning the nature of the key object.

Conditions:
The base in this scenario is different from the standard clonk base. You can only sell certain goods (gold, oil, eggs and some shinies), but can buy any amount of the available materials (however the price will increase when the stock is exhausted).

The magic tower won't refill magic energy automatically. The amount of energy absorbed from lightnings is reduced, too.

Hints:
·	While not required, a fully developed infrastructure will assist you greatly. So it's a viable strategy to start with setting up your settlment before going after the key objects.
·	Note that the key object will be recreated if lost. Feel free to destroy a key object that's giving you trouble.
�
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Sky Village
scenarios.description:
Sky Village

This round's goal is to build one castle and one blimp. Mind your step!

The construction plan is hidden on one of the sky islands and has to be found first.

Building materials are not required in this scenario.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Submarine
scenarios.description:
Submarine

The first clonks have developed new technology needed to access suboceanic resources. Use the submarine available to mine all corals you can find.

In this scenario the aquaclonk is also available, with the ability to swim and dive better than the regular clonk and perform various tasks under water.

Hint: lower an elevator case with a lorry into a large water basin and unload from the submarine directly into the lorry.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: The Treasure
scenarios.description:
The Treasure

In the middle of the desert, not far from the Snake River, lies a treasure of immense value: the holy three skulls of the desert clonks, which are considered highly valuable artefacts.

A group of archeologists has arrived to seize this treasure. But the skulls are deeply buried and can only be reached with a bit of ingenuity.

Your mission is to find, retrieve, and sell all three skulls.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Canyon Wars
scenarios.description:
Canyon Wars

A very popular terrain shape from the old times. 

Two groups of clonks are placed at the opposite sides of a wide and very steep canyon.

The cannon tower, which is available in this scenario, can either be used as a direct weapon or as a way of getting clonks in the enemy base.

Note: the first team that loses its captain (marked by a star) loses the match.

A team melee for up to six players.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: The Dark Castle
scenarios.description:
The Dark Castle

At the foot of a steep cliff live the people of a small village in which life could be very peaceful if there wasn't the evil Baron Herx living in his dark castle above.

The opposing players have very different starting conditions in this scenario. The first player controls the villagers. He has more clonks and more buildings but less money available. The second player has only one clonk but the better strategic position.

Baron Herx may easily start attacking the village from above while the people have to build tunnels and bridges to reach the top of the hill. After a while, however, both players will have to watch their resources and mine for gold to increase funds.

The people of the village may also consider establishing a safer underground base. They can for this purpose take the flag off their original base and put it into the new base building.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Clepal
scenarios.description:
Clepal

If you still think the people of the remote mountain state of Clepal would spend all day meditating peacefully, you have been far wrong. 

It is the custom of these people to resolve differences among neighbours immediately and on the spot through a little skirmish. And quite often you will see the use of the tradtional throwing weapon - the boomerang - during these proceedings.

An open team melee for up to 12 players. The rules are simplified, so you don't need material for buildings, and factories don't need energy supply.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Cliff Fight
scenarios.description:
Cliff Fight

On the steep banks of the Lenos river two clans fight an embittered battle for the valuable land. 

As both sides start with very basic villages, a certain amount of settlement work is required before a successful raid on the enemy can be attempted.

A build-up melee for 2 to 12 players.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Ore=3; Coal-Swirl=4; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Greed
scenarios.description:
Greed

Far below the surface some miners once discovered a type of gold which was four times as valuable as ordinary gold. This caused a tremendous rush towards these extremely deep mines.

Countless shafts were drilled to get to the valuable material. But one day an enormous earthquake destroyed most of the access shafts and the miners lost contact with the surface. While the surviving clonks waited for rescue, lava began to enter the few remaining tunnels.

But still jealousy among the miners prevailed and the situation got more intense every day. Until one day everything got out of control. Eveyone was so greedy for the gold that they would attack anyone nearing their own gold.

In this scenario, gold is worth four times its normal value. All building material on the other hand is extremely expensive. Setting up your own production facilities is recommended.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Massif
scenarios.description:
Massif

The goal of this scenario is to finally settle the hostilities between two clonk tribes separated by an immense rock massif in a final battle. 

Players are eliminated when their last flag is sold in order to avoid needless skirmishes and to support well thought out strategies. Members of clonk tribes share their wealth and knowledge; task sharing is a wise thing to do.

A medium size team melee for 2 to 12 players.

Landscape.Layers: Rock=7; Rock-Ridge=7; Gold=7; Granite=4; Ore=3; Coal-Swirl=4; Water-Smooth=5; Oil-Smooth=5; Earth-Rough=50; Earth-Smooth2=50;

scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Minor Melee
scenarios.description:
Minor Melee

The most basic and straight-forward battle scenario in Clonk for 2 to 12 players.

One clonk per player - everything else is open: run, dodge, jump, throw rocks. Weaken your enemy with rock or flint hits before challenging him to direct clonk-to-clonk battle.

As the battle progresses, heavier weapons will appear in the earth - they can be dug out and used for your purpose.

The goal is to eliminate all other players.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Mountain Combat
scenarios.description:
Mountain Combat

In the hills, clonks fight for each and every square meter...

This time they are meeting up in a mountain range with large crystal deposits which can be used to cast magic spells.

A bustling melee, everybody against everybody. Every player starts with one normal clonk and one magic clonk. Each player gets one special spell.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Shark Lake
scenarios.description:
Shark Lake

Since the direct way of attack is certainly not the most promising in this scenario, players need to develop new tactics for a successful raid.

Each player has enough time to strengthen his base by building new structues.

Sail boat and hot air balloon can be used to cross the lakes.

A basic melee for up to four players.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Theft
scenarios.description:
Theft

The two clans Rustuff and McClomby have been arguing for over twenty years now. Both want the land around Trudu River.

Now they have decided on a way to solve the conflict once and for all - through a competition. The team which sells the enemy's flag wins.

The goal is to kill all enemy clonks or sell the enemy flag, whichever is easier.

A classic capture-the-flag scenario for two players.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Cave Race
scenarios.description:
Cave Race

The first player to reach the the top of the map wins the game.

Cave Racing requires skill in working your way upwards underground using loam bridges and careful digging. Since all players are moving in the same direction, there will be a certain degree of teamwork at the beginning. Of course, only until the goal is in sight...

There is an unlimited relaunch for players whose clonks die in the race. Check the player menu in the game to see who's up front at any time.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Glowing Peak
scenarios.description:
Glowing Peak

High up on this mountain, there is a majestic dragon nest. Two groups of knights resolve to climb the mountain and attain the power of the dragons. As one team is approaching from the West and the other from the East, they do not know of each other. But the time is running, because only the first team to reach the top can be the master of the dragons!

A cooperative team race for dragon fanciers.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Gold Race
scenarios.description:
Gold Race

Gold has always fascinated clonks; every clonk wants to have as much of it as possible.

Try to be the first to grab the gold idol at the right border, and achieve grand riches!

A very quick race for beginner players.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Monster Rescue
scenarios.description:
Monster Rescue

The peaceloving green animals are in danger!

Nekrum, the head of an evil group of mages, has decreed that these animals have to be eliminated, because - as he claims - they are responsible for all the acid rain!

Each player controls one monster. Your goal is to reach the safe forest at the right end of the landscape.

Every team possesses a well equipped castle and a few weapons. The important rooms of each castle are the branch offices, the workshop, the lab and the storage. For every destruction of one of these rooms, the enemy gets a certain reward. If a team loses four important rooms or gets completely eliminated (there are five relaunches for every side), the enemy gets the claim for Hammerfest.

scenarios.title: Regicide
scenarios.description:
Regicide

The land is divided over disputes of wealth and influence. Some rebellious baronies already prepare to defect from the Crown. These times of conflict give the perfect opportunity to overthrow the King and seize absolute power. For this reason, the shadow blades –a mysterious order, led by dark knights –were hired to overcome the Royal Guard and to dispose of the King.

A tactical team melee for 2-8 players.

The Game:

-> The Royal Guard: These elite fighters are equipped to brave any danger. The first player of this team also gains control of the King, who needs to be protected at all cost.
Beneath the castle, old secret tunnels lead east to the safe castle of a loyal baron. In the old times, this passage was magically sealed to deny entry to assassins; unfortunately, the seal now closes the only means of escape. The King has already cast a spell to weaken the barrier, but it will still take some time until it is fully dispelled.
You need to hold the castle to the best of your possibilities until the escape is usable. When the barrier is gone, the King needs to reach the passage in the lower right to escape the mercenaries and win the round.
The King is adept at casting some useful spells.

-> The Shadow Blades: These mysterious soldiers have been charged with infiltrating the castle and eliminating the King. If you do not manage to do this before the barrier blocking the exit is dispelled, you need to intercept his escape.
To facilitate your task, your clients have sent some workers to your aid, who have already built a small base of operations east of the castle. You will find a workshop and an alchemy laboratory there. The escape tunnels are accessible directly from your base.
The most senior shadow blade of every player wears shadow armor. Furthermore, you have your pay of 150 clunkers at your disposal, should you need it.

Hints:

-The staircase entries of towers and drawbridges can be locked and unlocked by pressing throw or dig twice.
-You cannot rebuild destroyed buildings.
-Mining sulphur and other ressources might give your team the edge you need to overcome your foes.

scenarios.title: Arctic
scenarios.description:
Arctic

This is the home of the Inuit clonks, a people skilled in survival in this barren environment.

Most of their time the Inuit spend hunting and fishing, thus gathering food and materials needed to produce tools and all necessary equipment.

But beware, at those freezing temperatures nobody can survive long without shelter. Only with warm clothing the Inuk can travel outdoors for a length of time before he has to return to his warm igloo.

On extensive journeys the most important pieces of equipment, such as mallet, knife, harpoon, and if possible a life amulet should be carried along. A leather sack is very helpful here.

Population will increase whenever some members of the tribe stay home for a while, with enough food and enough living space. Normal igloos, however, are already fully occupied with two inhabitants.

Through the power of magical amulets an Inuk may become an Angakok, able to communicate with the spirits of nature.

Daylight will be long in summer, followed by permanent darkness in winter.

scenarios.title: Deep Sea
scenarios.description:
Deep Sea

Where not at single ray of sunlight reaches the ocean floor and atmospheric pressure would crush any normal settler is the home of the hydroclonks.

Hydroclonks are capable of holding their breath for an enormous amount of time, feed - it goes without saying - on fish, and erect complex underwater cities of their own design.

All buildings are made of the natural deep sea corals and ores which are processed in the foundry.

By creating dwelling units, additional hydroclonks can be attracted to join your settlement.

scenarios.title: Jungle
scenarios.description:
Jungle

Here in the deepest rainforest live the jungle clonks.

They erect settlements from simple huts, protective wooden guard towers and fences.

They produce all kinds of useful tools and weapons by hand, using the traditional rock mallet.

Using special amulets, the jungle clonks can achieve new knowledge through meditation and enhance their physical and mental abilities - such as more speed and strength in battle or basic magic skills.

As source of energy they hunt the local animals - birds, snakes, even piranhas - which are then prepared in the village's cauldron over a camp fire.

In case of conflicts with neighbouring tribes, the jungle clonks will not hesitate to use their native weapons: blow tube and arrows, spear, and slingshot.

This scenario is designed for tactical melees between several tribes but should offer ample entertainment for single players, too, who can perform research and build up settlements. For further playing it is recommended to adjust the starting coditions to your liking in the scenario properties.

scenarios.title: Alchemy
scenarios.description:
Alchemy

The secret art of alchemy is an ancient and treasured craft. 

When the alchemy rule is applied to a scenario, magic spells are no longer cast using magic energy but instead by using up individual alchemic ingredients. These can be gained by any clonk wearing an alchemist's bag by processing various items and materials. Produced ingredients are then stored in the invisibly carried bag.

Alchemic ingredients can also be used to brew a number of useful magic potions, in the magic cauldron.

When in search for a suitable location to carry out their experiments, the clonks of the alchemists guild had finally discovered an uninhabited cave system. Uninhabitated? Not quite.
The caves were full of animals of all kinds. But who can concentrate on their experiments while all those animals bustle about? Thus... they all had to go.

The objective of this scenario is to hunt down all animals and destroy all their nests. It is recommended to make use of the various magic potions while doing so.

scenarios.title: Bank Robbery
scenarios.description:
Bank Robbery

In the regions around the Clonk Canyon the ground is so rocky, that there's hardly any place suitable for building a settlement. But in the few places where mining is possible, great riches can be found. This, of course, attracts many bandits as well, so the gold-diggers must know how to defend themselves. 

A bank robbery scenario for 2-12 players.

The Game:

-The bandits have to steal money by bombing the banks and bring the money bags to their treasure chest. If they manage to get more money than the city people, they win. If they lose their last main tent, they lose the game..
-The miners already asked the cavalry for help. It will arrive in 15 minutes, supporting the town with troops, cannons and explosives. Therefore, the bandits should try to accomplish their goal before the time is up.
-The gangs have a secret storage not far away, which enables them to order cheap supplies (Main Tent: 'Up'). Those will be brought to their supply chest.
-A sheriff can be trained in the sheriff's office. He's able to arrest weakened bandits for a reward of 40 clunkers.
-Both sides share a certain amount of relaunches, so they shouldn't be wasted.

scenarios.title: Flag of Honor
scenarios.description:
Flag of Honor

To the far west of the frontier, two rivalling generals found an exceptionally fertile piece of land, which both of them now claim for themselves. As no agreement could be found, the idea comes up to run a competition known from the Indians, in which two tribes try to steal all calumets from each other. The tribe that gets them all is the winner. Since there are no calumets at hand, the rivalling companies decide to use flags instead.

A capture-the-flag team melee for 2-12 players.

The Rules:

-At the beginning, the host sets the amount of points required to win the game, using the rule "Capturelimit" in the menu (standard: 5).
-The goal is to steal the enemy flag and bring it to the own flag pole. It can only be delivered when the own flag is present. The team gets one point and a reward of 50 clunkers for each.
-If a team picks up the own flag that has been dropped or if it lies on the ground for more than about 2 minutes, it will be transported back to its flag pole immediately. This also happens if it is brought into one of the forts.
-A captain can be trained in the armory for a fee. There can be only one captain per side at the same time.
scenarios.scriptPlayerCountSource: No CreateScriptPlayer calls in official scenario or definition scripts

scenarios.title: Dead Man's Valley
scenarios.description:
Dead Man’s Valley

Far away from civilisation, Dead Man’s Valley is the perfect hideout for some of the most notorious bandits, and the one who call the shots here enjoys a lot of the doubtful fame. So it's no surprise that shortly after the arrest of the old gang leader became known, other bandits started fighting each other for the succession. 

A fast melee for 2-12 players.

The Game:
-Every player starts with an armed bandit having unlimited relaunches.
-The goal is to be the first one who reaches the number of points the host sets at the beginning of the game (default: 10).
-For every enemy killed you get one point and a reward of 20 clunkers which you can spend in the drugstores or saloons. For every suicide you lose one point.
-A boss can be hired for 80 clunkers in the telegraph station. He is very strong, has infinite ammo and gets 2 points per kill. Killing the boss gives a higher bounty of course! There can be only one boss at a time.
-The amount of points for winning the game can be altered by using the rule "Fraglimit" in the menu.

scenarios.title: Falling Stars Peak
scenarios.description:
Falling Stars Peak

Nearly everybody has heard of the legendary star rain of this peak. Once a year golden stars fall from the sky and have already made many lucky shooters very rich. At the right time each year hosts of cowboys go to this peak to try their luck. Because of the big run, even a saloon and a bank have been built so that the cowboys can spend their earned money right away. Also a sheriff’s office was constructed because of the bandits who are trying to get their share. So each cowboy also has to fend off bandits while pursuing his goal: to become as rich as possible, in the short time of the rain.

-Stars are falling from the sky - each gives different points or a time bonus. You can see the ranking of the stars in the display in the left upper corner. Here are also displayed the points and the time, as well as your current level.
-The hats on the right border of the display show you the number of available relaunches; the red bordered hats at the left show the number of bandits.
-By reaching 100 points your level will be raised by 1. But this will only happen if you have also killed all bandits. If not, only black stars will be falling until you have defeated all bandits.
-When you shoot a golden star, you will hold it in your hand. If you take it into the sheriff’s office, you will be made sheriff for a limited time. As sheriff, you gain the double amount of points for shooting stars.
-If you hit a dynamite box directly, you gain a relaunch.
-The money bags have to be brought to the bank. For this you get points and money.
-Shooting a whisky bottle restores your health.

Golden Canyon

For days the gold seekers had been on their way. After fighting against bandits and negotiating with Indians, they finally reached their destination, the Golden Canyon. Old Bill was right! Here in this deep canyon a lot of gold can be found. But there are dangers for the brave gold seekers. It never stops raining and heavy lightning keeps striking. There are also angry crows, which try to dissuade miners form their goal. Will they succeed in mining all the gold of this rich canyon?

Advanced mining for single and cooperative players.

The way there is said to hold many dangers, which is why no settler ever dared go there. scenarios.title: Miners Creek
scenarios.description:
Miners Creek

The setting sun glows on the horizon in soft red and the town of Miners Creek seems to be completely abandoned. A rumor went around that the most notorious bandit gang of the country is planning a raid on the city in order to get hold of the newly discovered goldmines. Troops of the national guard were already sent to source the old fort on the bank and defend the town!

A teamwork melee for 2-12 players.

The Game:

Cavalry: your primary objective is to defend the town of Miners Creek! Though you command a relatively secure fort, the enemy will try to destroy the civil buildings. Avoid that by all means and place guards a strategic points. If you manage to kill enough bandits or destroy their hideout, they will retreat and the battle is won. As a special bonus, the cavalry has access to a cannon as well as a second armory, which is constantly producing ammunition and cannonballs. Because the cavalry has greater manpower than the bandits, they can request reinforcements up to seven times (relaunches). Wanted criminals: because of the recent raids on their workers, the railway company will pay a considerable bounty for every bandit who gets killed in action. For most wanted criminals you will even receive a special reward!

Bandits: you and your gang barricaded yourself in a cave next to the town. You bandits are bombing-experts, and you should make use of this skill to destroy as many of the town's buildings as possible. For every destroyed building you’ll receive a different plundering-bonus (as you can see in the list below). If you manage to destroy six out of seven main buildings, the cavalry will declare the town as being lost and they will retreat. You can hire up to five new gangs during the fight (relaunches).
As a bonus for this team, the armory is regulary producing dynamite boxes up to a maximum of three pieces.

Hints:

-At the beginning of the game, the host is able to alter the number of relaunches and the amount of buildings and utilities (optional) that have to be destroyed, using the rule "Balancing".  That way it's possible to set handicaps for better players and customize the goals to suit your own wishes.
-If a team loses its flag, a new one can be created by pressing "Up" in the HQ (this process will cost 90 instead of 60 clunkers).
-Every armory is constantly producing ammunition, as long as there are fewer than ten boxes on stock.
-In case a team is able to destroy a main building of the enemy, it will receive a high reward (true for cavalry too).
-The bandits should consider about not destroying the saloon at the beginning since it is an important source for the vitalizing brandy.
-In case you run short of weapons, the camps offer everything you need to build new ones.
-During the game you get more detailed information about buildings, their dedicated reward and the number of relaunches for eacht team by selecting the appropriate goal in the goals-menu.

Totem Hunt
